methodology.metric: Competitors = sum of Leader+Follower headcounts over skill levels Newcomer, Novice, Intermediate, Advanced, All-Star, Champion. Exact from competitions dump when ≥2 skill divisions have both counts; otherwise Chart-5 tier midpoint estimate (~); else unique scored dancers.
methodology.comparison: Each edition vs the event's previous scored edition. One calendar year skipped → compare and mark after_1yr_break. Two or more years skipped → restarted (no %). No previous → new.
methodology.status: Growing/Declining when |pct| ≥ 10% and |delta| ≥ 10; otherwise stable (when comparable).
